subsystem.name: MathAndCollision
subsystem.responsibility: Rotation and matrix math helpers (rotation-matrix to Euler extraction, unit quaternion to rotation matrix, 3x3 matrix multiply), a contact-constraint stiffness-matrix assembly routine for the physics solver, and a mixed set of container/aggregate utilities (linear struct-array search by string, matrix identity column/row initialization with virtual dispatch, dual-list struct-array pool initialization at two scales, null-terminated string-array deep copy, and dynamic element-array growth). Owners are almost all unknown; the classes below are worker-proposed groupings, not recovered source types.

summary: Ten functions reconstructed around rotation math, constraint solving, and container utilities. Three math helpers operate on 3x3 row-major double matrices or an Euler triple: RotationMatrixToEuler (0x00566EE0) extracts three angles to this+0/+4/+8 with an FPU-status singularity branch, QuaternionToRotationMatrix (0x00566F40) expands a unit quaternion into nine double matrix elements, and Matrix33Multiply (0x0056C740) computes the nine dot products of two matrices and returns the output pointer. ConstraintStiffnessMatrixAssembly (0x0056BAF0) iterates constraint entries (88-byte stride) at this+0x240, cross-products axes, transforms them through the world inverse inertia via Matrix3x3VectorMultiply (0x00435E00), scales by inverse mass this+0xB4, and accumulates diagonal and type-selected off-diagonal blocks through the row-pointer table at this+0x228. The container utilities are heterogeneous: LinearSearchInStructArrayByString (0x0056EB30) walks 72-byte structs skipping null entries using string comparison 0x00588410; initMatrixIdentityColumnAndRow (0x0056EC70) either dispatches to a vtable+24 virtual or manually zeroes a column/row and sets a 1.0 diagonal on a pointer-array matrix representation; InitializeStructArrayPool (0x005823C0) and InitializeLargeStructArrayPool (0x005824F0) build size-scaled 4/16-slot dual-list pools through the NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb initializer; NullTerminatedIntArrayCopyWithAlloc (0x00598502) deep-copies a null-terminated string-pointer array with abort-on-alloc-failure; GrowDynamicElementArray (0x0059B530) grows a two-WORD-element array by a stride until capacity covers count+1. Four functions remain ownerless in function_roles because no common-ownership evidence exists.

function_roles.role: Rotation matrix to Euler conversion: writes x-angle atan2(-a1[5], sqrt(a1[3]^2 + a1[4]^2)) to this+0, then branches on FPU status word & 0x4100 left by the sqrt. Singularity branch writes y-angle atan2(-a1[6], a1[0]) to this+4 and zeroes this+8; normal branch writes y-angle atan2(a1[2], a1[8]) to this+4 and z-angle atan2(a1[3], a1[4]) to this+8. Returns the FPU status mask (non-zero when the singularity branch was taken).

Unit quaternion to 3x3 row-major rotation matrix: a1[0]=w, a1[1]=x, a1[2]=y, a1[3]=z; doubles each component, forms the pairwise products, and writes nine matrix elements to a2[0..8] with 1-(zz+yy), 1-(zz+xx), 1-(yy+xx) on the diagonal. Pure computation with no branches.

Constraint stiffness matrix assembly for a contact-constraint solver: reads the constraint count at this+0x23C as loop bound and initial return value, guards on count>0, then walks the entry buffer at this+0x240 with 88-byte stride. Per entry loads axis doubles at +24/+32/+40 and +64/+72/+80, an index dword at +48 and a type byte at +52, cross-products the axes, transforms them via Matrix3x3VectorMultiply on the world inverse inertia, scales by inverse mass this+0xB4, and accumulates the diagonal block through the row-pointer table at this+0x228. An inner loop over subsequent entries computes off-diagonal coupling terms, adding when the two type bytes match and subtracting otherwise. Returns the last row index, consumed by InertialTensorVectorTransform.

3x3 matrix multiply: computes the nine output entries of a3, each a dot product of one row of a1 with one column of a2 (row-major over nine doubles at 0x0..0x40), and returns the unmodified a3 pointer. Structural twin of Matrix3x3VectorMultiply per cluster_copy prelabel; called from suspension and collision transform paths.

Linear search over an array of 72-byte structs that skips null entries: returns 0 when the element count at this+0x18 is <= 0; otherwise walks the array base at this+0x1C with stride 72, continuing while the element string pointer is null or string comparison 0x00588410 reports non-match, and returns this+0x1C + 72*index on the first non-null match or 0 when exhausted.

Matrix identity init for one column and one row: when the vtable pointer at this+0x30 is non-null, delegates to the virtual method at vtable+24; otherwise zeroes the 8-byte elements of column a2 (via the column pointer array) and row a2 (via the row pointer array) for each index in [0, this[8]), sets the diagonal element to 1.0 (high 32-bit word 1072693248), zeroes the matching row element at this+0x2C, and returns this[11] (the row-pointer array address).

Struct-array pool initialization (4 slots): allocates a 4-byte wrapper, a 164-byte pool array (4 sub-objects of 40 bytes plus a 4-byte slot-count header), stores the slot count 4, runs NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb over 4 slots with 40-byte stride invoking the StructInitializationWithVTable and sub_57AEF0 callbacks under the SEH_5823C0 handler, wraps the pool in a 12-byte node marked free, and appends it to list1 (head this+0x0, tail this+0x4, cursor this+0x8, count this+0xC). Then pre-allocates one 12-byte free node per sub-object slot into list2 (head this+0x10, tail this+0x14, cursor this+0x18, count this+0x1C), leaving every slot node free. Returns the last list2 count.

Struct-array pool initialization (16 slots), size-scaled counterpart of 0x005823C0: zeroes the dual-list header this[0..7], allocates a 4-byte wrapper and a 644-byte pool array (16 sub-objects of 40 bytes plus a 4-byte slot-count header), stores the slot count 16, runs NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb over 16 slots with 40-byte stride under the SEH_5824F0 handler, wraps the pool in a 12-byte free node appended to list1, and pre-allocates 12-byte free nodes per slot into list2. Returns this.

Null-terminated string-pointer array deep copy: returns 0 when the input pointer is null; otherwise walks the array counting elements until a null terminator (first element from offset 0, subsequent from offset 4 upward), allocates 4*(count+1) bytes via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc, aborts via CRTAmsgExit(9) if the allocation fails, copies each entry through StringAllocCopy, writes a null terminator, and returns the new array base.

Dynamic element-array growth: returns 1 when used count + 1 (this+0x14) does not exceed capacity this+0xC; otherwise computes new capacity starting at growth stride this+0x1C plus capacity and adding the stride until it covers count+1, allocates a 4*i byte buffer (two WORDs per element) via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper returning 0 on failure, zero-initializes it, copies the first this+0x14 elements from the old array this+0x8, frees the old buffer via FreeWrapper_7bcf, and updates this+0x8 (pointer) and this+0xC (capacity). Returns 1 on the no-growth and success paths.

classes.name: RotationMatrixMath
classes.responsibility: Free-function rotation/matrix helpers over 3x3 row-major double matrices: unit-quaternion expansion into nine matrix elements (0x00566F40) and 3x3 by 3x3 multiplication (0x0056C740) reading matrix slots at 8-byte stride 0x0..0x40. The class is a thematic grouping; the matrix element slots are shared layout, not proven ownership.

classes.name: EulerAngleMath
classes.responsibility: Rotation-matrix to Euler-angle extraction writing three angle doubles to an output buffer at this+0/+4/+8, with an FPU-status singularity branch that collapses the z angle to zero.

classes.name: ConstraintStiffnessMatrixBuilder
classes.responsibility: Sparse constraint stiffness-matrix assembly for the contact solver: reads the constraint count at +0x23C and entry buffer at +0x240 (88-byte stride), scales axis cross products by inverse mass at +0xB4, transforms them through the world inverse inertia, and accumulates diagonal plus type-selected off-diagonal blocks through the row-pointer table at +0x228. The world-inverse-inertia operand of the Matrix3x3VectorMultiply call is described in the packet but not listed among its allowed field evidence refs.

classes.name: StringKeyedStructArray
classes.responsibility: Linear search container over 72-byte struct entries keyed by an embedded string: element count at +0x18, array base at +0x1C, null entries skipped, string equality decided by an external comparison helper. Returns the matching element pointer or 0.

classes.name: MatrixIdentityInitializer
classes.responsibility: Matrix column/row identity initialization on a pointer-array matrix representation: dimension at +0x20, column-pointer array at +0x28, row-pointer array at +0x2C, vtable at +0x30. Either dispatches to a virtual method at vtable+24 or manually zeroes a column and row and sets a 1.0 diagonal.

classes.name: StructArrayPoolManager
classes.responsibility: Dual-list struct-array pool initialization at two scales (4 and 16 slots): list1 header at +0x0/+0x4/+0x8/+0xC (head/tail/cursor/count) holding one container node that wraps a pool array with a slot-count header, list2 header at +0x10/+0x14/+0x18/+0x1C holding per-slot free nodes. The two entry points are size-scaled counterparts and are grouped as one class, but common ownership is not proven by the packet.

classes.name: DynamicElementArray
classes.responsibility: Growable array of 2-WORD elements: data pointer at +0x8, capacity at +0xC, used count at +0x14, growth stride at +0x1C. Grows by repeated stride addition, allocates and zero-initializes the new buffer, copies the used prefix, frees the old buffer, and returns success/failure.

compatibility_contracts.name: EulerExtractionContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Rotation-matrix to Euler conversion writes three double angles to the output buffer at +0/+4/+8 and returns the FPU status mask (status word & 0x4100); a non-zero return indicates the singularity branch was taken, in which case the z angle is written as 0.0. A replacement must preserve the output layout, the angle formulas, and the singularity return value.

compatibility_contracts.name: QuaternionToMatrixContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A unit quaternion (w,x,y,z) expands into a 3x3 row-major rotation matrix: a pure computation writing nine elements with 1-(zz+yy), 1-(zz+xx), 1-(yy+xx) on the diagonal and the six off-diagonal products in the standard quaternion-to-matrix arrangement. A replacement must preserve the element formulas and the output write order.

compatibility_contracts.name: MatrixMultiplyContract
compatibility_contracts.description: 3x3 matrix multiply computes each output entry as the dot product of one row of the left matrix and one column of the right matrix over the nine-double row-major layout, and returns the unmodified output pointer. A replacement must preserve the row-major element order, the multiplication semantics, and the returned pointer.

compatibility_contracts.name: ConstraintStiffnessAssemblyContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Contact-constraint stiffness assembly iterates the constraint buffer at +0x240 with 88-byte stride up to the count at +0x23C, scales transformed axis cross products by inverse mass at +0xB4, and accumulates diagonal plus type-selected off-diagonal blocks through the row-pointer table at +0x228; entries sharing the type byte add while differing types subtract. The function returns the last processed row index. A replacement must preserve the stride, the add/subtract type selection, the sparse addressing, and the return value.

compatibility_contracts.name: StringKeyedStructArraySearchContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Linear search over a null-skipping 72-byte-stride array: returns 0 for an empty or exhausted array and the matching element pointer otherwise, where a match is a non-null string pointer that the external comparison helper reports as equal. A replacement must preserve the null-skip behavior, the 72-byte stride, and the zero-vs-pointer result contract.

compatibility_contracts.name: StructArrayPoolInitializationContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Dual-list pool initialization builds a pool array with a slot-count header, runs a callback loop over each 40-byte slot, wraps the pool in a free container node appended to list1, and pre-allocates one free node per slot into list2. A replacement must preserve the slot count, the 40-byte slot stride, the free-node layout (payload/next/flag), and the list head/tail/cursor/count fields at +0x0..+0x1C.

compatibility_contracts.name: NullTerminatedArrayDeepCopyContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Deep copy of a null-terminated string-pointer array: null input returns 0, otherwise the array is counted, allocated as 4*(count+1) bytes, each entry deep-copied, and a null terminator written. Allocation failure terminates the process through CRTAmsgExit(9). A replacement must preserve the null-terminator counting, the allocation size, the deep copy of every entry, and the abort-on-failure behavior.

compatibility_contracts.name: DynamicElementArrayGrowthContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Dynamic array growth triggers when used count + 1 exceeds capacity, grows by repeatedly adding the growth stride until it covers the need, allocates and zero-initializes a 4*i byte buffer, copies the used prefix, frees the old buffer, and updates the pointer/capacity fields. Returns 1 on the no-growth and success paths and 0 only on allocation failure. A replacement must preserve the growth rule, the copy, the free, and the return contract.

unresolved: Owners of all ten functions are unknown and left as UnknownObject in function_roles; the classes are worker-proposed thematic groupings and are not recovered source types.

RotationMatrixToEuler (0x00566EE0): the read global flt_5B8968 is listed in the packet but does not appear in the raw source text; its role as EulerSingularityThreshold is unverified. The axis-to-angle mapping (pitch/yaw/roll) is inferred from existing analysis, not from the raw source.

QuaternionToRotationMatrix (0x00566F40): global flt_59E43C (physics constant per skeleton fill) is listed as a read global but no reference is visible in the raw decompiled source; its role here is unexplained.

ConstraintStiffnessMatrixAssembly (0x0056BAF0): the type byte at entry+52 that selects add/subtract accumulation is DERIVED from control flow; the sparse-matrix layout and 8-byte element size behind the row-pointer table at +0x228 are inferred; the 88-byte entry stride and axis field offsets are inferred from loop arithmetic. The world-inverse-inertia operand of the transform call is described in the packet but has no allowed field evidence ref.

Matrix33Multiply (0x0056C740): row-major layout is inferred; a column-major interpretation is equally compatible with the field offsets. Caller 0x0056F100 is unnamed, and the claimed structural-twin relationship with Matrix3x3VectorMultiply was not verified here.

LinearSearchInStructArrayByString (0x0056EB30): sub_588410 is treated as a string comparison returning 0 on match per existing analysis, but its exact contract is not part of this packet; the concrete 72-byte struct type and why entries may be null are unverified.

initMatrixIdentityColumnAndRow (0x0056EC70): the matrix representation (dimension at this[8], column/row pointer arrays at this[10]/this[11]) is inferred from access pattern; the 8-byte element stride implies double entries but is not proven; the literal 1072693248 as the high 32-bit word of IEEE-754 double 1.0 is an interpretation; the virtual method at vtable+24 semantics are unknown.

InitializeStructArrayPool (0x005823C0) / InitializeLargeStructArrayPool (0x005824F0): the two-list pool/queue consumer semantics live in external callers and are not determined here; the SEH handlers (SEH_5823C0 / SEH_5824F0) are not analyzed; whether the two functions share a common list-manager object type is not established - equal offsets on independent this pointers are not proof of identity, so the StructArrayPoolManager class grouping is a GUESS.

NullTerminatedIntArrayCopyWithAlloc (0x00598502): the structure of objects returned by StringAllocCopy is unknown; the CRTAmsgExit(9) exit code meaning is unresolved; offsets 0 and 4 are the first two int slots of the walked array with caller-defined semantics.

GrowDynamicElementArray (0x0059B530): the 2-WORD element semantic (clip-rect entries) is DERIVED from existing analysis; the owner object type is UNKNOWN; only the caller BitmapAllocationTracker (0x0059B5C0) is known.

RotationMatrixMath and EulerAngleMath overlap on field offsets 0x00/0x04/0x08 (matrix element slots vs Euler output triple). The packet does not prove these are the same object, so the two classes are kept separate rather than merged.

QuaternionToRotationMatrix records its nine output fields at 4-byte-spaced offsets (0x00..0x20) while Matrix33Multiply reads matrix slots at 8-byte stride (0x00..0x40); the two layouts are not proven to describe the same element type, so the class fields keep each function's own packet offsets.
